FAQ

Pricing Questions. Answered.

Are there any hidden fees?

Absolutely not. The price you see is the price you pay. We will never surprise you with additional charges. If your project scope changes, we will discuss it upfront before any extra work begins.

What is your payment structure?

50% deposit to begin, 50% on launch. For larger projects, we can split into 3 payments (30/40/30). We accept bank transfer, credit card, and PayPal.

What if I need changes after launch?

Every plan includes post-launch support. After that period, we offer monthly maintenance retainers starting at $500/month for ongoing updates, optimizations, and support.

Do you offer refunds?

We do not offer refunds, but we do offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee. If you are not happy with the work, we keep revising until you are. We have never had an unsatisfied client walk away.

Can I upgrade my plan later?

Yes. Many clients start with Starter and upgrade to Business or Growth as their needs evolve. We will credit what you have already paid toward the new plan.
